title: Rolling average of CPU samples
hints: Loop over the indexes with range(len(samples)) and take a slice ending at i for each one.
The window is samples[start:i + 1] where start = max(0, i - n + 1); the max() keeps start from going negative, which would slice from the wrong end.
sum(window) / len(window) is the mean; len(window) is smaller than n at the start, which is exactly what you want. Wrap it in round(..., 2).
